title: Nigel: The Agent of Chaos
summary: Nigel: The Agent of Chaos — meet the newest member of the Carleton Pack.
content:
If Monty is the stoic veteran of the Carleton household, Nigel is the high-energy recruit who disrupted everything. Entering the scene in 2022, Nigel didn't just walk into the house—he launched what experts call a "hostile takeover" attempt. However, the incumbent power, Monty, held his ground, leading to a decade-defining power struggle that eventually settled into a playful brotherhood.

The Perpetual Puppy

Even though it has been three years since his arrival, Nigel has defied the laws of canine aging. He maintains a "perpetual puppy" energy level that keeps the household on its toes. Recently, Nigel has expanded his horizons beyond the living room, enrolling in training and social play groups to channel his boundless enthusiasm into more "productive" chaos.

Shared Solidarity

In a show of pack solidarity, Nigel follows the same dietary restrictions as Monty. Whether out of necessity or simply wanting to match his big brother, Nigel is fueled by the same specialized medical food, proving that you don't need meat or dairy to maintain a 24/7 zoomie schedule.

Puppy Review: The Nigel Files

The Territory: The Yard

Rating: 10/10 (Spacious)
Nigel's Review:
"The outdoor arena is magnificent. High-speed running lanes, plenty of acoustics for barking at nothing, and soft grass for tactical rolls. It is the perfect place to ambush Monty."

The Hobby: Annoying Monty

Rating: 7/10
Observations:
Nigel finds great satisfaction in pestering his elder, though he has learned to respect the 'couch boundary' (mostly). It is a consistent 7/10 on the fun scale, only losing points when Monty actually barks back.

The Training Evolution

Status: Work in Progress
Documentary Note:
Nigel’s recent entry into play groups suggests a new chapter. He is learning that other dogs exist besides Monty, though none provide quite the same level of wrestling competition as the original pack leader.

Note: This article was written with the assistance of AI, based on interviews with the Carleton Siblings.
